description: This file defines the RecipeListAdapter class, which implements the ListAdapter interface to provide data and views for a list of recipes in an Android application. It loads recipe data from a JSON asset, parses it, and creates list item views with title, summary, and image.

classes.name: RecipeListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for displaying a list of recipes in an Android ListView, loading data from JSON assets and creating views for each recipe.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Inner class representing a recipe item with title, name, summary, and image.

methods.name: RecipeListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing context and loading the recipe list.

methods.name: loadRecipeList
methods.description: Loads the recipe list JSON asset and parses it into items.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses JSON object to extract recipe items.

methods.name: appendItemsToList
methods.description: Adds parsed items to the internal list and notifies observer.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of recipe items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the recipe item at a given position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a list item view, populates it with recipe data.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates whether item IDs are stable (false).

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: areAllItemsEnabled
methods.description: Returns true, indicating all items are enabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns true for item at position, indicating it is enabled.

methods.name: getItemName
methods.description: Returns the name of the recipe at a given position.
